title: One contraction filter repairs a common output margin on all quantum extensions

statement.quantifiers: Any finite faithful target density sigma and density eta, with delta=||eta-sigma||_1/2; every quantum extension x of eta.
statement.assertion: One full-domain CPTP Repair fixes eta to sigma and T(id_R tensor Repair(x),x)<=sqrt(delta)+delta/2 simultaneously for all finite references.
assumptions: Exact common output marginal eta across tested states.
Faithful sigma, possibly singular eta; full-domain effect-plus-preparation completion.

inputs: eta,sigma only; no tested joint state/reference or information budget.
outputs: One physical common repair and a reference-uniform error bound.
interface.precision: Exact analytic error; faithful weight inversion may be numerically poorly conditioned.
costs: Matrix inverse square root, state/effect coordinates and synthesis precision not free.
No dimension/eigenvalue factor in the analytic error does not establish efficient acquisition.

proof_mechanism: K=sqrt(sigma)M^-1/2 is a contraction, K eta K*<=sigma and failure p<=delta.
Complete K(.)K* with effect F=I-K*K and preparation (sigma-KetaK*)/p.
Purify every extension and apply the fixed filter/completion bound; postprocess both broadcaster outputs.
obstructions: Repair gives stationarity, not KMS symmetry.
Varying output margins cannot silently share this channel.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Identify one actual common margin and keep the repair state-independent and reference-uniform before later comparison.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed and adversarially audited mathematics with scoped finite checks; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
